channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Tesla Reportedly Plans Optimus Reservations for Early December
item.description: Humanoids Summit founder Modar Alaoui told The San Francisco Standard that Tesla plans reservations around its December event. Consumer delivery terms remain unclear.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: What Is Worken? AGIBOT’s Proposed Measure of Productive Robot Work
item.description: AGIBOT’s Worken framework combines active robots, autonomous hours and task-specific output. Here is how the calculation works—and what it cannot tell you.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Optimus Data-Collection Effort Comes Into Focus After Scoble’s “Robot University” Claims
item.description: Tesla job listings document motion-capture work and multi-shift data collection, while Robert Scoble’s claims about camera-covered suits and a Palo Alto operation remain unverified.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility Robotics Expects $465M in Gross Capital Ahead of SPAC Merger Closing
item.description: The expected financing includes $100 million already received. Agility targets a November 4 closing and November 5 Nasdaq debut, subject to shareholder approval and closing conditions.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: HALO Teaches Humanoids to Coordinate With Human Partners During Shared Carrying Tasks
item.description: Researchers at UT Arlington and Carnegie Mellon demonstrate human–humanoid coordination, with motion-capture-supported tests showing both gains and remaining failures.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT GO-3 Preview Links Robot Pre-Training, Practice and Learning on the Job
item.description: AGIBOT pairs GO-3 Preview with Genie Evolver and Genie Master to connect pre-training, physical and virtual practice, and learning from deployment experience.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: How AGIBOT’s Physical Reasoning Dataset Connects Planning With Robot Actions
item.description: A closer look at how AGIBOT WORLD Release 4 uses changing task conditions, memory and spatial annotations to connect decisions with robot movements.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Bleu Robotics Raises €5M to Teach Industrial Humanoids New Tasks in Under an Hour
item.description: The French startup is developing robot-learning software that it says needs around ten demonstrations, with initial factory deployments still ahead.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Introduces Worken, New AI Models and G2 Max at Innovation Day 2026
item.description: AGIBOT proposes a measure of productive robot work alongside AHA3 hardware, GO-3 Preview, WITA-Omni 1.0, G2 Max and an open-source roadmap for Link-U OS.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Physical Intelligence Reportedly Seeks $1B at a $20B Valuation
item.description: Reported funding talks follow PI’s API beta launch, while Sergey Levine explains why data and learning across robot bodies underpin its strategy.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s Quarterly Revenue Surges 70% as R&D Spending Weighs on Profit
item.description: Unitree reports 665 million yuan in Q3 revenue, while profit falls 17.4% and R&D spending rises 249.6%. A prior-year one-time expense complicates its nine-month earnings comparison.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Robbyant’s Embodied AI Challenge Will Send 15 Teams to a Real-Robot Final in Shanghai
item.description: Robbyant tells Humanoids Daily that finalists will use AgileX’s Cobot Magic in a 48-hour hackathon. Tasks, scoring and advance access arrangements remain under development.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Audi Tests Agile Robots’ Mobile Humanoids for Automotive Parts Sequencing
item.description: Audi’s Ingolstadt proof of concept pairs Agile Robots’ mobile humanoids with virtual testing from Dassault Systèmes and NVIDIA, as automakers explore robotic material handling.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Reward AI Shows OM-1 Handling Deliveries, Stairs and Household Chores
item.description: Reward AI’s latest OM-1 video features delivery, stairway picking and household tasks, following its September debut of a policy trained on human demonstrations.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LG Targets Home Humanoids Around 2030, With Robots and Appliances Designed to Work Together
item.description: LG’s Q3 call outlines a path from industrial robotics to household use, with affordability, compatible appliances, training data and actuator production central to the plan.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Says IRON’s Solid-State Battery Has Entered Small-Batch Production
item.description: Vice president Gu Jie reports limited battery production while IRON remains pre-SOP. The exact production chemistry and performance specifications remain unclear.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: DeepMind Pairs Genie 4 With Gemini Argon to Simulate Apollo Playing Checkers
item.description: The interactive world model takes task instructions from Argon as it generates a simulated Apollo scene, offering an early glimpse of reasoning-guided robotics environments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week’s Newsletter: Voxel, Unitree H2-X and Europe’s Humanoid Push
item.description: Catch up on Voxel’s home-robot pitch, Unitree’s H2-X showcase, Europe’s new humanoids and training facilities, and our latest features in the free weekly briefing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Luxonis Launches OAK 4 FFC to Put Five Robot Cameras on One Vision Computer
item.description: The compact board supports custom camera layouts, onboard depth and AI processing, and scene-based calibration. The $849 developer kit is shipping now, with cameras sold separately.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Machenta Raises $40 Million to Teach Robots New Tasks From One Demonstration
item.description: The London startup says its simulation-trained model can adapt to new tasks without fine-tuning, with early demonstrations extending to humanoid hands.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: WorldOracle Tests Whether World Models Can Reliably Predict Real-World Executions
item.description: WorldOracle tests whether action-conditioned world models predict what robots actually do, revealing gaps in object motion and long-horizon accuracy.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Lars Moravy Floats Optimus as a Cybercab Charging Helper
item.description: In a Munro Live discussion, Moravy suggests Optimus could help Cybercab use existing charging infrastructure, without announcing a firm deployment timetable.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Taps Korean Suppliers for Atlas, With 10,000-Robot Preparations Reported
item.description: KED Global reports a Hyundai Mobis-led component lineup and preparations for 10,000 Atlas robots. Final order quantities and prices remain undecided.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Employee Petition Against ICE Robot Deal Tests Its Ethical Guardrails
item.description: The company is standing by a deal for four modified Spot robots despite employee objections, highlighting questions about customer selection and safeguards beyond weaponization.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Faraday Future Completes Robotics Business Transfer to Nasdaq-Listed FFR
item.description: The acquisition closed October 23. FFR forecasts approximately 2,000 robot sales and shipments for the acquired business in 2026 and introduces FF OmniMind.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla’s Optimus Gen 3, Figure 04 and the Next Apollo: When Each Could Be Revealed
item.description: Tesla, Figure and Apptronik are each preparing a new humanoid, and none has given a reveal date. Here is what each company has said, what our reporting adds, and when each robot is most likely to appear.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GXO Expands Agility Partnership to Two More U.S. Sites, Starting With Digit 4
item.description: Digit deployments in North Carolina and Tennessee are expected in early 2027, with a later transition to Digit 5 when commercially available.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ROKAE Reports 10,000 Humanoid Arms Delivered, Identifies Schaeffler Factory Deployment
item.description: ROKAE says five Helios wheeled humanoids work on Schaeffler’s Taicang component line, adding supplier detail to the factory’s robot deployment.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Schaeffler COO Sees Humanoid Opportunities in Components, Factories and Services
item.description: In a Gasgoo interview, Jochen Schröder outlines how humanoids could support component sales, factory productivity, customer integration and robot maintenance.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ETH Zürich Teaches a Humanoid to Climb, Vault and Recover by Planning Body Contacts
item.description: Tested on a Unitree G1, the research combines human motion data and reinforcement learning to connect mobility skills using onboard terrain sensing.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
